guiding_question: If Constitutional Capitalism were adopted tomorrow, what would we measure so that we could honestly determine whether it succeeded?
note: Phase 2 partial after CC-PHASE-2.1-BASELINE-LEGITIMATE-SLOT-EXPANSION-CONTINUATION-1.0: arc 27/64→38/64 (this pass 34/64→38/64). Continuation fills only; Census failures logged not worked around.

metrics.title: Median household wealth
metrics.definition: Real median family net worth from Federal Reserve SCF (2022 dollars).
metrics.limitations: Survey-based; family unit; not identical to DFA household sector.

reproducible_retrieval.method: Open Fed SCF bulletin / SCF tables; median family net worth (2022 dollars)

metrics.numerator_denominator: SCF survey estimate — median of family net worth distribution

metrics.title: Net worth by decile
metrics.definition: DFA wealth shares by wealth percentile groups (FRED release tables).
metrics.limitations: Quarterly model-based; revisions possible; not SCF micro shares.

reproducible_retrieval.method: Open FRED/DFA distribute tables for wealth percentile shares; record quarter

metrics.numerator_denominator: DFA modeled wealth shares by percentile group

metrics.title: Asset ownership
metrics.definition: Percent of U.S. families owning any financial asset (transaction accounts, CDs, bonds, stocks, pooled funds, retirement accounts, cash-value life insurance, other managed assets) — SCF.
metrics.limitations: Nearly universal due to transaction accounts; not a measure of productive capital ownership. Direct stock ownership is lower (~21%).
metrics.numerator_denominator: families with any financial asset / all families

reproducible_retrieval.method: Fed SCF Bulletin tables / interactive SCF table — Percent Holding — Any financial asset

metrics.title: Homeownership
metrics.definition: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied (ACS homeownership rate).
metrics.limitations: Occupied-unit universe. SCF family homeownership (66.1% in 2022) is a different unit — do not mix without labeling.
metrics.numerator_denominator: owner-occupied units / occupied housing units (85.7M / 131.3M in ACS-61 narrative)

reproducible_retrieval.method: data.census.gov → ACS 1-year → table B25003 Tenure for United States; or ACS-61 report

metrics.title: Retirement ownership
metrics.definition: Percent of U.S. families holding retirement accounts (IRA/Keogh and certain employer-sponsored accounts such as 401(k)/403(b)/TSP) — SCF.
metrics.limitations: Ownership ≠ adequacy of balances; conditional medians are separate metrics.
metrics.numerator_denominator: families with retirement accounts / all families

reproducible_retrieval.method: Fed SCF 2022 bulletin — retirement accounts ownership rate

metrics.title: Wage growth
metrics.definition: 12-month percent change in real average hourly earnings for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls (CES), CPI-U deflated, seasonally adjusted.
metrics.limitations: Mean AHE of jobs, not median worker wages; excludes most government; recent months preliminary.
metrics.numerator_denominator: index/level change in real AHE over 12 months

reproducible_retrieval.method: BLS Real Earnings news release Table A-1 — over-the-year percent change, real AHE all employees

metrics.title: Productivity
metrics.definition: Annual percent change in labor productivity (output per hour) in the nonfarm business sector — BLS Productivity and Costs.
metrics.limitations: Sector coverage excludes general government and several nonbusiness activities; subject to revision.
metrics.numerator_denominator: real output index / hours-worked index (growth rates)

reproducible_retrieval.method: BLS Productivity and Costs annual averages — nonfarm business labor productivity

metrics.title: Ownership (worker/employee)
metrics.definition: Ownership (worker/employee) — definition to be finalized with source methodology.
metrics.limitations: Structure only until sourced in Phase 2.

metrics.title: Job mobility (voluntary quits rate)
metrics.definition: BLS JOLTS annual average quits rate for total nonfarm employment: 100 × (sum of 12 monthly quits levels) / (sum of 12 monthly CES employment levels).
metrics.limitations: Operational redefine from vague 'job mobility' to voluntary quits. Quits exclude layoffs and many employer-to-employer transitions not coded as quits. Not a Census job-to-job flow measure.
metrics.numerator_denominator: annual quits / annual CES employment (JOLTS Table 22 method)

reproducible_retrieval.method: BLS JOLTS Table 22 — Total row, year 2024 annual average quits rate

metrics.title: Apprenticeships
metrics.definition: Count of active registered apprentices in the U.S. Registered Apprenticeship system during the federal fiscal year (DOL OA / RAPIDS; includes SAA and USMAP in national totals).
metrics.limitations: Registered only; not all apprenticeships/internships; military USMAP included.
metrics.numerator_denominator: count of active apprentices (stock during FY)

reproducible_retrieval.method: apprenticeship.gov apprentices-by-state dashboard / CRS Table 1 active apprentices

metrics.title: Small-business lending (CRA originations)
metrics.definition: Aggregate dollar amount of CRA-reported small business loan originations (original amounts of $1 million or less) in the report year.
metrics.limitations: Coverage limited to CRA reporters. 'Small loan' ≠ necessarily 'small firm' unless using revenue ≤ $1M breakouts. Not a rate.

reproducible_retrieval.method: FFIEC/OCC CRA national tables — small business loan originations dollar amount for year

metrics.title: Market concentration
metrics.definition: Industry-level concentration of largest firms (CR4/CR8/CR20/CR50; HHI where published) from the Economic Census Establishment and Firm Size / concentration tables — not a single national scalar.

current_value.rationale: A single US-wide concentration percentage would misstate the measure; authoritative objects are industry CR/HHI cells.

metrics.limitations: Concentration ≠ competitive harm. Product-market definition matters. Advocacy averages (e.g. mean C4) are secondary and not used as the CC value.
metrics.numerator_denominator: sales/shipments of largest N firms / industry total (per industry cell)

reproducible_retrieval.method: data.census.gov → table EC2200SIZECONCEN (2022) — concentration of largest firms

reproducible_retrieval.method: Census Urban Areas Facts table — Percent population living within rural areas

metrics.title: Local banking (community-bank domestic deposit share)
metrics.definition: FDIC-defined community banks' domestic office deposits as a percent of all FDIC-insured institutions' domestic deposits (QBP quarter-end).
metrics.limitations: Community-bank label is FDIC criteria-based. Deposit allocation across offices follows SOD/internal methods. Not credit-union inclusive.
metrics.numerator_denominator: community-bank domestic office deposits ($2,327,241M) / industry domestic deposits ($17,748,000M)

reproducible_retrieval.method: FDIC QBP Table II-B community-bank domestic office deposits ÷ FDIC industry domestic deposits (Statistics at a Glance / QBP) for same quarter

metrics.title: Volunteerism
metrics.definition: Formal volunteering rate: percent of population age 16+ who volunteered through an organization in the prior year (CPS Civic Engagement and Volunteering Supplement).
metrics.limitations: Formal organization volunteering only; reference period Sep–Sep.
metrics.numerator_denominator: formal volunteers / population 16+

reproducible_retrieval.method: Census/AmeriCorps CEV release — national formal volunteering rate

metrics.title: Marriage
metrics.definition: Provisional crude marriage rate: marriages per 1,000 total population (NCHS NVSS).
metrics.limitations: Provisional; occurrence-based; not share currently married.
metrics.numerator_denominator: marriages / mid-year population × 1,000

reproducible_retrieval.method: CDC NCHS FastStats Marriage and Divorce; confirm provisional year

metrics.title: Birth rates
metrics.definition: General fertility rate: births per 1,000 females ages 15–44 (NCHS final natality).
metrics.limitations: Locked to GFR (not TFR 1.621). Do not mix with crude birth rate.
metrics.numerator_denominator: live births / female population 15–44 × 1,000

reproducible_retrieval.method: NCHS Births: Final Data — general fertility rate table

metrics.title: Child poverty
metrics.definition: Official poverty rate for people under age 18 (CPS ASEC official poverty measure).
metrics.limitations: Official ≠ SPM (SPM child poverty 13.7% in 2023). ACS child poverty differs. Do not mix measures.
metrics.numerator_denominator: children below official poverty threshold / all children

reproducible_retrieval.method: Census P60 poverty report / Table A-1 age detail; confirm Official Poverty Measure, under 18

metrics.title: Household savings
metrics.definition: BEA personal saving as a percentage of disposable personal income (annual national accounts rate).
metrics.limitations: Macro flow rate — not median household bank balances. Title says household; series is personal sector.
metrics.numerator_denominator: personal saving / disposable personal income × 100

reproducible_retrieval.method: FRED series A072RC1A156NBEA or BEA Personal Income and Outlays / NIPA Table 2.1 annual

metrics.numerator_denominator: (always + most of the time) / valid responses

reproducible_retrieval.method: ANES 2024 Time Series codebook/frequencies for trust-in-government item; sum Always + Most of the time

metrics.title: Incarceration rate

metrics.numerator_denominator: sentenced prisoners / resident population × 100,000

reproducible_retrieval.method: BJS Prisoners in [year] Statistical Tables — imprisonment rate, all ages

metrics.title: Jail detention / pretrial population
metrics.definition: Jail incarceration rate: persons held in local jails per 100,000 U.S. residents at midyear (BJS Jail Inmates). Companion composition: share unconvicted.

current_value.note: Rate is primary scalar; unconvicted share is composition of jail population (~70% midyear 2023).

metrics.limitations: Midyear; pretrial/unconvicted is composition not a separate rate series.
metrics.numerator_denominator: jail confined / resident population × 100,000

reproducible_retrieval.method: BJS Jail Inmates in [year] — incarceration rate and conviction status

metrics.title: Campaign funding concentration (top-decile share of congressional candidate receipts)
metrics.definition: Share of aggregate House+Senate candidate total receipts held by the top 10% of House+Senate candidates with receipts > 0 in the FEC weball all-candidates file for the election cycle.
metrics.limitations: Derived concentration on FEC weball universe (2,733 HS candidates with receipts>0 in retrieved file). Universe/sum can differ from FEC 24-month statistical summary (2,152 candidates; $3,801.5M). Not donor-level concentration. Excludes presidential and independent-expenditure-only committees.
metrics.numerator_denominator: sum(receipts of top decile by receipts) / sum(receipts of all HS candidates with receipts>0) × 100

reproducible_retrieval.method: Download https://www.fec.gov/files/bulk-downloads/2024/weball24.zip; parse weball24.txt; keep Cand_ID starting H/S; TTL_RECEIPTS (field 6) > 0; sort descending; top ceil(0.1*N) share of sum

metrics.title: Community bank / credit union lending share
metrics.definition: Combined FDIC community-bank total loans & leases plus NCUA federally insured credit-union total loans, as a percent of (FDIC-insured industry total loans & leases + NCUA CU total loans), same quarter.
metrics.limitations: Adds bank and CU systems with distinct charters. Excludes non-depository lenders. Community-bank definition is FDIC-criteria.
metrics.numerator_denominator: (community-bank loans $1,933.394B + CU loans $1,650B) / (industry bank loans $12,725B + CU loans $1,650B)

reproducible_retrieval.method: FDIC QBP community-bank loans + NCUA Q4 loans; divide by FDIC industry loans + NCUA loans

metrics.title: Small-business and rural capital access indicators
metrics.definition: Two-component indicator: (1) Federal Reserve Small Business Credit Survey share of employer-firm loan/line/MCA applicants fully approved for financing sought in the prior 12 months; (2) USDA FSA Farm Loan Programs total dollar obligations in the federal fiscal year.
metrics.limitations: SBCS is applicant approval among employer firms, not a population credit-access rate and not rural-specific. FSA covers farm loan programs only, not general rural small-business credit. SBA 7(a)/504 dollar series remains SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_DATA_PENDING (primary workbook retrieval failed this pass).
metrics.numerator_denominator: (1) fully approved applicants / applicants with resolved loan/line/MCA outcomes; (2) sum of FSA FLP obligation dollars

reproducible_retrieval.method: Fed SBCS 2025 Report on Employer Firms — 2024 survey full-approval percent; USDA FSA FY2024 Executive Summary total amount
